test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the correct full form of RPO?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage mentions that the Government of India **boosts** renewable energy consumption through legally binding purchases called **Renewable Purchase Obligation (RPO).**
 
• This program **mandates **states to purchase a certain amount of their energy from renewable sources, promoting the use of renewable energy.
 
• **In summary, option 3 – Renewable Purchase Obligation – aptly reflects the policy mentioned in the passage aimed at promoting renewable energy consumption in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Renewable Purchase Operations:** This phrase does not accurately capture the legal binding aspect of RPOs that the passage describes.
 
• **Revenue Purchase Obligation:** This term does not pertain to the renewable energy sector or the context presented in the passage.
 
• **Review Public Obligations:** This option does not relate to renewable energy or the context of legally binding energy purchases discussed in the passage.
